content.short: Walapay provides stablecoin-powered API infrastructure for moving and managing money globally.
content.description: Walapay offers stablecoin-based APIs for global money movement and treasury management, aimed at businesses that want settlement speed without operating crypto infrastructure themselves. Monad's documentation lists it among onramps. The pitch across this category is consistent: stablecoins as plumbing the end customer never sees.
